stories.explanation: Dont 40 portent sur des candidats innovants du portefeuille.
stories.story_fr: Merck compte environ 60 essais de phase 3 en oncologie, dont 40 portent sur des candidats innovants.
stories.story_en: Merck has approximately 60 Phase 3 oncology trials, of which 40 are across novel pipeline candidates.
stories.citation: In total, we now have approximately 60 Phase 3 oncology trials, of which 40 are across novel pipeline candidates

stories.name_fr: Opportunité commerciale du portefeuille oncologie avancé
stories.name_en: Commercial opportunity of the late-stage oncology pipeline
stories.explanation: Opportunité non ajustée du risque, hors acquisition de Terns.
stories.story_fr: Merck voit plus de 25 milliards de dollars d’opportunité commerciale, non ajustée du risque, pour son portefeuille oncologie avancé d’ici le milieu des années 2030.
stories.story_en: Merck sees more than $25 billion of non-risk-adjusted commercial opportunity from its late-stage oncology pipeline by the mid-2030s.
stories.citation: We continue to see greater than $25 billion in nonrisk-adjusted commercial opportunity from our oncology late-stage pipeline alone by the mid-2030s

stories.story_fr: Merck a l’opportunité de lancer 14 nouveaux produits en oncologie, couvrant plus de 80 nouvelles indications.
stories.story_en: Merck has the opportunity to bring 14 new cancer products to market across more than 80 new indications.
stories.citation: we have the opportunity to bring 14 new products to market for the treatment of cancer across more than 80 new indications

stories.name_fr: Indications Keytruda approuvées par la FDA
stories.story_fr: Keytruda est approuvé par la FDA pour 44 indications couvrant 19 types de tumeurs.
stories.story_en: KEYTRUDA has received FDA approvals for 44 indications across 19 tumor types.
stories.citation: KEYTRUDA has now received FDA approvals for 44 indications across 19 tumor types

stories.name_fr: Indications Keytruda approuvées aux stades précoces
stories.explanation: Régimes à base de Keytruda aux stades précoces.
stories.story_fr: Les régimes à base de Keytruda ont reçu l’approbation de la FDA pour 11 indications aux stades précoces.
stories.story_en: KEYTRUDA-based regimens have received FDA approval for 11 indications in the earlier setting.
stories.citation: KEYTRUDA-based regimens have received FDA approval for 11 indications in the earlier setting
